mentions.name: summond
mentions.description: Developer- and agent-friendly tool for interacting with macOS Launch Control. It aims to support all relevant Launch Control triggers via a TOML config format, with dynamic environment control, logs, and dotfile-friendly configuration.
mentions.source_excerpt: I've also been working on `summond` (https://github.com/joshgummersall/summond), a developer/agent friendly way to interact with OSX Launch Control. It aims to support all relevant Launch Control triggers using a nice `toml` config format, dynamic environment control, logs, and more.
